nvitk.io.writers.nifti¶

Write volumes to NIfTI (and optional JSON sidecar / header extension) via nibabel.

nvitk.io.writers.nifti.write_nifti(path: str, data: Any, *, axes: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, save_metadata_extension: bool = True, **_: Any) → None¶

Save data to path as NIfTI; writes a sibling .json when extra metadata is JSON-safe.

Reorders from metadata['axes'] to axes when both differ. Zooms come from x_res / y_res / z_res / t_res (or aliases). With save_metadata_extension=True, a nibabel header extension may embed additional JSON metadata.
